title: CQRS: Move side effects out of aggregate command handlers
description: bitcoin_wallet_aggregate.dart:470-575 writes to secureStorage before event persistence

title: Add double-initialization guard to LibSpiffyActorSystem
description: libspiffy_actor_system.dart:141 has no protection against multiple initialize() calls.

title: Make PaymentChannel model immutable with copyWith
description: payment_channel.dart:78-114 has mutable fields. 50+ mutation sites across projections and storage.

title: Replace polling loops with Completers in actors
description: wallet_manager_actor.dart:563-578 polls with Future.delayed. invoice_coordinator uses 200ms delays.

title: Fix fake transaction hex in CreateTransactionCommand
description: bitcoin_wallet_aggregate.dart:1207 uses placeholder 'unsigned_tx_' string that crashes projections.

title: Architecture: Decompose wallet god aggregate
description: bitcoin_wallet_aggregate.dart ~2500 lines. Split into UTXO, signing, and address sub-aggregates.

title: Fix actor isolation: HeaderSyncActor direct method calls
description: libspiffy_actor_system.dart:876-883 calls methods directly on _headerSyncActorInstance bypassing mailbox.

title: Centralize key derivation out of coordinator actors
description: Duplicated in PaymentCoordinatorActor:425-490 and BenfordCoordinatorActor:432-487. Should be in WalletManager.

title: Security: Remove private keys from WalletImportStartedEvent
description: wallet_events.dart:113-115 stores xpriv/wif in event stream. Keys should only be in SecureStorage.

title: Make aggregate state objects immutable (copy-on-write)
description: WalletState/InvoiceState/ChannelState mutate in place. Need copy-on-write semantics.

title: Replace runtimeType dispatch with Dart 3 pattern matching
description: All aggregates and actors use switch(command.runtimeType) instead of exhaustive pattern matching.

title: Fix premature success response in InvoiceCoordinator
description: invoice_coordinator_actor.dart:488-506 responds before aggregate confirms. Use ask pattern.
